body:
`SeaIceMomentumEquation(grid; rheology = nothing)` builds, but `update_state!` (and so every time step) of a model that uses it throws:

```
MethodError: no method matching prognostic_fields(::SeaIceMomentumEquation{...}, ::Nothing)
```

`prognostic_fields(model, mom::SeaIceMomentumEquation)` asks the rheology for its prognostic fields, and only `AbstractRheology` had a method. This adds the one for `nothing`.

The new test time-steps a model without a rheology with the explicit and split-explicit solvers; it fails without the change.

title: Define the prognostic fields of a momentum equation without a rheology
